messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: creating a compact handoff for the new welcome nudge + webinar pre-invite. Goal: clear segs, send windows, seed checks, and who owns the rollback. Short sync here.
Ravi Patel: I'll assemble the segmentation matrix. Proposed buckets: trial_new (0-3d), trial_active (4-21d), webinar_interest, partner-referrals. Suppress: unsubscribed, recent_bounced, support_case_open.
Lena Kowalski: Creative ready. Two subject lines to test on trial_new: "Welcome to Redwood — Quickstart in 10 min" and "Ship LLM features faster with Redwood". Footer will surface the webinar CTA (next Tue).
Sam Ortiz: Deliverability notes: run DNS validation, small ISP sample, then 1k seed panel. Set alert for spike in hard bounces >0.35% in first 30m. ops-bot please.
ops-bot: scheduled: dns_check, seed_send_1k at 2028-04-11T16:00:00Z; alert rule created: hard_bounce>0.0035 in 30m window
Aaron Blake: Send plan suggestion: Canary 7% Tue 11am PT, Ramp 33% Wed 11am PT, Final 100% Thu 10am PT. APAC stagger +26h. Include throttling on provider side.
Maya Chen: Canary stop criteria: hard_bounce > 0.35% OR delivery_delay_median > 600s. Who watches first 45m?
Sam Ortiz: I'll monitor first 45m; set Slack alert and PagerDuty if thresholds hit. Also include an internal failsafe: cancel remaining rollout batches if problem detected.
Ravi Patel: Adding columns for timezone, last_active, and email_score for priority routing. Will export CSV with snapshot_time included for suppression consistency.
Lena Kowalski: A/B CTA text: "Start integration" vs "Explore quickstart". We'll route best-performer to trial_active after 48h. Also add UTM: utm_campaign=welcome_orbit_v2.
Maya Chen: QA checklist: 1) seed inbox checks (Gmail, Outlook, Apple) 2) link+UTM validation 3) unsubscribe flow check 4) image host tokens 5) transactional headers present. Lock content by EOD.
Sam Ortiz: Seed list: 80 internal aliases + 120 ISP external + 800 panel. Sending plan posted to the sheet.
Aaron Blake: Send config payload for infra team:
```
{"send_windows":["2028-04-12T18:00:00Z","2028-04-13T18:00:00Z"],"stagger":"tz_aware","rollout":[7,33,100],"provider_throttle":2000}
```
Maya Chen: Owners recap: Segs = Ravi, Copy = Lena, Deliverability = Sam, Ops/send = Aaron. I'll publish the short playbook in Notion and tag product-marketing + growth. Final go/no-go tomorrow 9am PT.
Ravi Patel: I'll drop the CSV link once export finishes.
Sam Ortiz: Locking subjects now so inbox previews can be captured.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — ping here with any last-minute blockers. :rocket:
